observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== webui container processes ===" && docker exec workspace-webui-1 ps aux 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "exec failed"
echo "=== webui logs tail ==="; docker logs workspace-webui-1 --tail 8 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== webui API ==="; curl -s -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "webui / HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3333/
echo "=== frontend login redirect check ==="; for p in / /login /en /en/login /auth/login; do echo -n "$p -> "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -m 10 -L http://localhost:3000$p; done
